text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends prohibiting parking anytime on both sides of Flora Drive within the bend of the road between a point 120 metres east of Porter Crescent and a point 67 metres further north/east, in order to prevent vehicles from parking within the bend of this roadway, blocking residential driveways and keep the sight lines clear. Currently, there is an unposted default three-hour parking limit in effect on Flora Drive.
Scarborough Community Council deferred consideration of the item to the first quarter of 2019.
